children: Overview
Germany rail solutions provider's H1 2026 revenue fell 9.6% yr/yr due to project delays
EBITDA for H1 2026 rose sharply, driven by cost savings and improved efficiency
Company lowered 2026 revenue and EBITDA forecast due to ongoing project delays and legal charge
Outlook
SBF AG lowers 2026 revenue forecast to €38.0-41.0 mln from €38.0-45.0 mln
Company cuts 2026 EBITDA guidance to €1.8-2.4 mln from €1.8-4.4 mln
SBF expects H2 2026 revenue to match H1, but earnings to be lower due to project delays and a legal charge
Result Drivers
COST SAVINGS - Relocation of production to České Budějovice delivered expected cost savings and reduced operating expenses
PROJECT DELAYS - Revenue decline was mainly due to delayed call-offs from ongoing projects
PRODUCTION EFFICIENCY - Increased production efficiency and greater use of synergies within the Group supported profitability
